scope: Separate development mechanism study, frozen before executing any of the24 original warmups. The externally pinned Git commit and complete source closure identify execution bytes.
execution_order: version, task, head, seed; rotate the four declared methods left by fit ordinal modulo4; all96 slots mandatory

proposal.myopic: H1 uses one-step current4 mean plus0.25 old4 mean. It is an explicitly different proposal endpoint, scored at the same actual32-step terminal.
proposal.remaining: At committed step k, Full, Loss2 and terminal-field predict the same absolute terminal32 with horizon32-k from the observed complete state and a zero-intervention Adam continuation.
proposal.local_problem: Linearized weighted endpoint loss plus(dt*rho/2)*norm(u)^2, with one free first action and coordinate box[-4/sqrt(p),4/sqrt(p)]. No predicted old hard constraint.
proposal.prefix_equivalence: For this separable linear-risk, diagonal-effort box QP, the first action equals that of any longer free prefix. This does not equate nonlinear block safety, future actions, H8 controllers or replanned trajectories.
proposal.first_step_parity: All four forecast maps coincide when remaining=1. Loss2 preserves8-output immediate feedthrough while its transported state contains only two aggregate losses.
proposal.terminal_field: R_k=C_T A_(T-1)...A_k has eight rows; z_(k+1)=z_k+R_(k+1)B_k du_k preserves the local terminal output. Complete state supplies its coefficients. Not an autonomous nonlinear Markov observer or an intermediate-path certificate.
proposal.adaptive_tail: Future policy replans and future safety-filter decisions are not differentiated. Predictions are conditional on the nominal zero tail, not forecasts of the subsequent adaptive closed loop.
proposal.oracle_cost: Full computes terminal panel derivatives only. Field also forms its eight-row initial observable. Loss2 computes intermediate aggregate panel observations. Charge each actual method construction separately; no shared result cache or free Full oracle.

safety.order: Same intended one-step proposal and complete origin: try the bounded V7 single-ray search first, then the bounded actual-old joint search only if the first fails to certify. No prefix splice or Full-risk fallback.
safety.bounds: Original four warmup old-panel losses, original post-Adam action box, zero acceptance slack. Recheck complete metadata, receipts, physical action and all four actual losses before adoption.
safety.information: All methods share the same full-state old-gradient safety layer. Loss2 limits the risk proposer, not the information available to the complete executing system.
safety.failure: Retain every failed paid attempt. Any nested actual error stops without adopting that step, even if a later portfolio branch produced a certificate. Finite search exhaustion is not global infeasibility. No zero-action substitution or anchor reset.
safety.retention_scope: Repeated empirical panel protection only. These adaptively reused labels cannot supply an independent population-retention certificate.

post_seal_development_evaluation.when: Only after all96 control slots and complete available physical prefixes are sealed; score into a separate directory without changing the control seal.
post_seal_development_evaluation.data: Exactly the already disclosed historical V5/V6 future_test512 and old_test512 roles, with existing pinned source identities and cached features. No new cohort or evaluator key is accessed.
post_seal_development_evaluation.report: All24 fits by four methods: future/old NLL and accuracy, paired differences versus H1 and Loss2, old versus original warmup, per-seed variability and eight cohort-task-head means. Report stopped/error outcomes without substituting32-step outcomes.
post_seal_development_evaluation.selection: No additional policy/configuration selection within this study. terminal_field8_remaining is the declared candidate; Full is its matched endpoint/frequency information-equivalent reference.
post_seal_development_evaluation.limits: These are development outcomes, not new confirmation. Do not relax the original future upper CI<-.001, old upper CI<=0, complete32 and CPU<=3 requirements or select a fresh cohort in response to these labels.

cost_scope: Measure entire per-policy caller interval: complete-state preparation, proposal, all failed safety work, cloning, contracts and adoption/terminal checks. Common historical input loading, disk persistence, independent replay and historical DEV scoring are separate. Report candidate/H1 and field/Full for all complete pairs, marking incomplete comparisons unavailable; no assumed3x pass.
evidence: Every available state/action/receipt/old-panel path; retained complete checkpoints0,16,17,32 and actual terminal; all attempted proposal maps and nominal terminal vectors, field initial observable, full paid search ledgers. No native handoff qualification is claimed.
freeze_contract: Host-pinned source commit, canonical executed source map and protocol byte hash. Status must be FROZEN before any real fit. Local hashes bind bytes; they are not independent authentication or scientific approval.
infrastructure_failure: Retain partial artifacts and paid measurements, stop without a complete control seal. Never recode failed storage as a scientific model outcome or claim an unavailable prefix was verified.
